text:
Decision: Focus first on GitHub and Reddit as the core sources for AI mining, then expand to Product Hunt and Telegram only if the first two prove insufficient.

Reasoning: GitHub and Reddit already host massive, high-signal communities where AI tools and discussions thrive. They’re easier to scrape and parse than fragmented Telegram groups or niche Product Hunt launches. Starting here maximizes early returns with minimal setup.

Trade-off: We’re delaying coverage of Product Hunt and Telegram, which might miss some viral launches or niche but high-quality tools. But if GitHub/Reddit yield enough, we avoid wasting time on harder-to-mine sources early on.
